parsed.rationale: All four types — `AccentHueKey`, `AccentSaturationKey`, `AccentBrightnessKey`, and `LCDActiveBrightnessKey` — are distinct `EnvironmentKey` conformances in `AccentColorEnvironment.swift` within the `PlayerHeaderView` package. Each key encodes a semantically independent color-space dimension (hue, saturation, brightness) or a separate display-state value (LCD active brightness). Their structural similarity (all are `type-alias-object` with no fields) is an artifact of the SwiftUI `EnvironmentKey` pattern, which requires one concrete type per key by design. Collapsing them would destroy the per-dimension type identity that SwiftUI's environment system depends on.
